title: Grateful Dead Live at Golden Hall, Community Concourse on 1982-02-19
lineage: 6th row center:  Sony ECM 220T mics on hats > Sony TCDM5 Cassette tape on Sony FeCr Type III tapes with Dolby B OnPlayback by Rango Keshavan Nak DR1 EQ Type II, Dolby B On > Sony PCMR500 DAT deck SBM On > Monster Digital Coax Cab

ai_review.summary: A mixed‑quality recording that still delivers the high energy of a 1982 San Diego show, highlighted by a smoking Other One and a fresh Lost Sailor suite.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its fire—especially the thunderous bass line on The Other One and the breezy Lost Sailor > Saint of Circumstance sequence—while the recording swings between crystal‑clear moments and noticeable monitor wash, out‑of‑phase issues, and occasional vocal dropouts. Listeners who sit a few rows back will hear a more balanced mix, but the show’s overall vigor shines through.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show highly (5‑star comments) while recording quality opinions range from excellent to fair, yielding an overall rating around four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners report moments of crisp sound but also monitor wash, out‑of‑phase balance issues, thin mids on Dire Wolf, vocal dropouts and occasional P.A. focus lag; overall listenable but not consistently clear.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set energy with a standout Lost Sailor suite; second set opens a bit weak but gains momentum through Space and an explosive Other One, keeping the overall pacing lively.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar work noted as lively (cutting loose on Cassidy, fancy needlepoint on his tiger) though sometimes out of phase; overall tone praised by some listeners.
band_member_comments.Phil: Thunderous bass line on The Other One repeated five times, highlighted as a highlight of the night.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals on El Paso described as swallowed and at times over‑powered by slide guitar; occasional vocal dropouts noted.
